meta.title: 入水跌肘【导致】前伸沉肘【导致】抱水溜肘
meta.title_en: Dropped Elbow at Entry → Sunk Reach → Slipped Catch

scenes.context: 自由泳的跌肘，十个成人八个肘先入水。入水时能听到啪啪的拍水声；减阻是不可能的，还会导致接下来前伸沉肘，基本上就和高肘抱水说再见了。
sentences: 自由泳的跌肘，十个成人八个肘先入水。
In freestyle, eight of ten adults drop the elbow at entry.
dropped elbow（跌肘）
自己都能听到每一次入水的啪啪声。
You can hear the slap with every entry.
slap（拍水声）
减阻是不可能减阻的，还会导致前伸沉肘。
No drag reduction—it just leads to a sinking reach.
sinking reach（前伸沉肘）
scenes.speak: In freestyle, eight of ten adults drop the elbow at entry. You can hear the slap with every entry. No drag reduction—it just leads to a sinking reach.

scenes.title_en: The Root Cause: Dropping the Shoulder
scenes.context: 很多人入水时肘先掉下去，根源都是肩先掉了下去。正确的动作是在移臂入水时，肩膀都是在水面上的；手入水后，随着前伸的动作，肩膀才会随着转下去。
sentences: 跌肘的罪恶之源是掉肩。
The root of the dropped elbow is the dropped shoulder.
root cause（根源）
正确动作是移臂入水时，肩膀在水面上。
Correctly, the shoulder stays above water at entry.
above water（水面上）
手入水后，随着前伸肩膀才转下去。
Only as the hand enters and reaches does the shoulder follow.
follow（跟随）
scenes.speak: The root of the dropped elbow is the dropped shoulder. Correctly, the shoulder stays above water at entry. Only as the hand enters and reaches does the shoulder follow.

scenes.context: 正确的入水顺序是手、肘、肩。但跌肘的朋友手还没入水，肩膀就已经先入水掉到水里了；肩都入水了，连接肩的大臂就会入水，大臂入水了，自然肘也就先入水了。
sentences: 正确的顺序是：手、肘、肩。
The correct order is: hand, elbow, shoulder.
sequence（顺序）
跌肘的朋友手还没入水，肩膀已经先入水了。
Elbow-droppers send the shoulder in before the hand.
send in（先入水）
肩入水带动大臂入水，肘自然也就先入水了。
Shoulder down drags the upper arm, and the elbow follows first.
drag（拖带）
scenes.speak: The correct order is: hand, elbow, shoulder. Elbow-droppers send the shoulder in before the hand. Shoulder down drags the upper arm, and the elbow follows first.

scenes.title_en: Hold the Shoulder, Hold the Elbow
scenes.context: 在一臂入水的过程中，肩一定要撑住。手不粘水，肩膀都应该是在水面上撑着的，不能提早往下掉；随着前伸手入水、肘入水、最后才是肩膀入水。肩撑住了就等于肘撑住了。
sentences: 移臂入水时，肩一定要撑住。
Through the entry, the shoulder must stay supported.
supported（撑住）
手不粘水，肩膀都应该在水面上撑着。
Before the hand touches water, the shoulder rides high.
ride high（撑在水面）
肩撑住了，就等于肘撑住了。
Hold the shoulder, and you hold the elbow.
hold（撑住）
scenes.speak: Through the entry, the shoulder must stay supported. Before the hand touches water, the shoulder rides high. Hold the shoulder, and you hold the elbow.

scenes.title_cn: 第二个因素：手入水姿态
scenes.context: 除了肩的问题，还有一个因素导致很多新手跌肘：手入水的姿态。肩膀柔韧性一般的成年人用平插入水，就很容易跌肘；建议采用斜插入水，手掌手腕稍微向外侧转一点，肘就撑起来了。
sentences: 手入水时是斜插还是平插？
Do you enter flat or at an angle?
enter（入水）
柔韧性一般的成年人平插入水，很容易跌肘。
Less flexible adults often drop the elbow with a flat entry.
flexible（柔韧性好的）
斜插入水，手掌手腕稍微向外侧转一点，肘就撑起来了。
Enter angled with the wrist rotated out and the elbow lifts.
rotate outward（向外转）
scenes.speak: Do you enter flat or at an angle? Less flexible adults often drop the elbow with a flat entry. Enter angled with the wrist rotated out and the elbow lifts.

scenes.context: 想要不跌肘：第一，入水时肩不要往下掉、要撑住，肩撑住就等于肘撑住，肩掉就等于肘掉；第二，建议新手采用斜插方式入水，手稍微向外侧倾斜一点，更容易把肘架住，平插更容易肘部掉下来。
sentences: 入水时肩要撑住，肩掉就等于肘掉。
Support the shoulder at entry—shoulder down means elbow down.
shoulder down（肩下沉）
新手建议用斜插的方式入水。
New swimmers should enter at an angle.
angled entry（斜插入水）
手向外侧倾斜一点，更容易把肘架住。
A slight outward tilt helps prop the elbow up.
prop up（架住）
scenes.speak: Support the shoulder at entry—shoulder down means elbow down. New swimmers should enter at an angle. A slight outward tilt helps prop the elbow up.

practice: Dropped elbow at entry leads to a sinking reach and a slipped catch.
The root cause is the shoulder dropping before the hand enters.
The correct order is hand, elbow, shoulder.
Hold the shoulder at entry, and you hold the elbow too.
Enter at an angle with the wrist rotated out to prop the elbow.
pitfalls: Eight of ten adults drop the elbow—check your shoulder height.
十个成人八个肘先入水。
The shoulder must ride high until the hand touches water.
Angled entry with a turned-out wrist props the elbow up.
Hand → elbow → shoulder; never shoulder first.
Shoulder down means elbow down—fix the shoulder first.
shifts: 用 dropped elbow（跌肘）、sinking reach（前伸沉肘）、slipped catch（抱水溜肘）
用 ride high（撑在水面）、support（撑住）、follow（跟随）
